title: Gideon and the Regiment
author: Tamsin Marchetti
blurb: Zephyrine Iversen, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
